name: count-up-animation
title: Count Up Animation
description: Count Up Animation is a free React number ticker that rolls each digit to its new value when it scrolls into view or when the value changes, with a roll and a count style, Intl.NumberFormat formatting for currency, percent, compact numbers and any locale, and the final figure kept in the HTML.
author: Wensity <hey@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)
theme.font-display: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

light.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

dark.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/count-up-animation.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add count-up-animation.
